approval: Draft branding; selected style reference is approved, derived avatar/banner require user approval.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / ads-marketing. Create a finished square YouTube channel avatar, requested 1024x1024.
Input image is the USER-SELECTED IDENTITY AND DRAWING STYLE anchor. Reproduce this EXACT fictional mature bearded traveler's face and style: restrained hand-drawn 2D animation, fine natural dark contour lines, gently painted cel shadows, warm brown eyes, wavy brown hair with gray at temples, salt-and-pepper beard. Natural adult facial proportions, subtle expressive eyebrows. Must remain DRAWN like the supplied man, not a photoreal person, not glossy 3D, not anime exaggeration, not heavy comic hatching.
Composition: intimate head-and-shoulders portrait centered in a square, face looking at viewer with warm quietly curious half-smile, entire hair and beard comfortably inside a circular crop. His ochre mustard jacket, cream henley and dark backpack straps visible at shoulders. Face dominates the small-icon composition. Simplify tiny lines to remain readable at 98px. Same recognizable face, age, hairline and beard outline as the reference.
Background: subdued ULTRA-PHOTOREALISTIC ancient stone arch out of focus, very dark teal with soft warm sun glow. Only the host is drawn. Amber rim light and soft warm facial shadows consistent with the scene. Clean finished premium adventure brand image.
No text, no logo, no letters, no border, no drawn circle, no inset circle, no frame, no other people, no hands. Full square opaque background.

Use case: ads-marketing / identity-preserve. A complete finished YouTube channel banner for NUVIKO HISTORY, landscape 16:9 requested 2560x1440.
Input image is USER-SELECTED face and DRAWING STYLE reference only. Keep this exact mature traveler, wavy dark hair graying at temples, salt-and-pepper beard, ochre jacket, cream henley and dark backpack. He must be a restrained HAND-DRAWN 2D animated man with fine dark contour and soft cel shadows, same subtle proportions and face as reference. NOT photoreal, NOT glossy 3D, NOT anime exaggeration.
World: ULTRA-PHOTOREALISTIC cinematic landscape, ancient Roman stone street and arches on left, distant medieval hill town toward right and a discreet steam train on a viaduct at far right. Different eras form a coherent brand panorama, not one claimed historical place. Warm golden-hour light, natural stone texture, believable atmospheric perspective, deep teal shadows and warm ivory highlights. Do not turn the background into an illustration.
YouTube crop layout: the traveler's COMPLETE head and ALL text must be inside the central phone-safe rectangle, centered 60% of width and 28% of height. At requested 2560x1440 this is approximately x=510..2050, y=520..920. Keep extra margin inside it. Small traveler on left of this safe strip: head about x=720..980, y=550..850. His torso may continue downward naturally toward bottom edge; no hard horizontal cut, no rectangular portrait insert. Photograph-like lighting on drawn man matches environment sun direction, shadows and warm bounce.
Text EXACTLY: "NUVIKO HISTORY" in large elegant readable warm-ivory editorial serif, placed x=1040..1940 y=650..760. Below it, smaller widely spaced clean sans serif "STEP INSIDE HISTORY" x=1070..1910 y=810..850. Both lines fully phone-safe. Behind text: dark quiet atmospheric scenery for contrast. Main title and face roughly equal emphasis. Upper and lower bands are scenery, no other essential content.
No other text, no numbers, no UI, no guide lines, no frames, no circular portrait, no watermark, no fantasy portal. Avoid pasted sticker edges. Full-bleed polished channel banner.
